<script>
    function AdvanceSearch(detai) {
        var theloai = '';
        $('#filter_theloai_div input:checked').each(function () {
            theloai += $(this).attr('id') + ','
        });
        if (theloai) {
            theloai = '&theloai=' + theloai
        }
        var multiplayer = ''
        $('#filter_multiplayer_div input:checked').each(function () {
            multiplayer += $(this).attr('id') + ','
        });
        if (multiplayer) {
            multiplayer = '&multiplayer=' + multiplayer
        }
        window.open('/filter-' + detai + '/?p=1' + theloai + multiplayer, '_blank');
    }
</script>

    <script>
    $(function () {
        $.extend($.ui.autocomplete.prototype.options, {
            open: function (event, ui) {
                $(this).autocomplete("widget").css({
                    "width": ($('.container').width() + "px"),
                });
            }
        });
        $('#seach_txt').autocomplete({
            source: function (request, response) {
                // Tạo FORM và gán giá trị
                var data = new FormData()
                data.append("tukhoa", request.term);
                data.append("detai", 'game');
                $.ajax({
                    type: "POST",
                    url: "/Post/Search",
                    data: data,
                    contentType: false,
                    processData: false,
                    success: function (data) {
                        response($.map(data, function (item) {                          
                            return {
                                baivietId: item.baivietId,
                                detai: item.detai,
                                ten: item.ten,
                                tendaydu: item.tendaydu,
                                tentv: item.tentv,
                                theloai: item.theloai,
                                url: item.url,
                                thumbnail: item.thumbnail,
                                ngayphathanh: item.ngayphathanh
                            }
                        }))
                    },
                    error: function (result) { }
                });
            },
            focus: function (event, ui) {
                // Rê chuột
                //$('#<%=txtSearch.ClientID%>').val(ui.item.ten);
                //return false;
            },
            select: function (event, ui) {
                // Chọn
                $('#seach_txt').val(ui.item.ten);
                return false;
            }
        }).data("ui-autocomplete")._renderItem = function (ul, item) {
            // Định dạng hiển thị
            if (item.detai == "game") {
                return $("<li>").append("<a href='/" + item.detai + "/" + item.url + "-" + item.baivietId + "' target='_blank'><img src='" + item.thumbnail + "' style='width:10%; margin-right:20px'/>" + item.tendaydu + "</a>").appendTo(ul);
            }
            if (item.detai == "software") {
                return $("<li>").append("<a href='/" + item.detai + "/" + item.url + "-" + item.baivietId + "' target='_blank'><div class='row clearfix' style='margin:0; display:block'><img src='" + item.thumbnail + "' style='width:10%; margin-right:20px; float:left'/><h4 style='padding-top:5px; font-size: 16px; color: black'>" + item.tendaydu + "</h4><span>" + item.theloai + "</span></div></a>").appendTo(ul);
            } else {
                var dateString = item.ngayphathanh.substr(6);
                var currentTime = new Date(parseInt(dateString));
                var year = currentTime.getFullYear();
                return $("<li>").append("<a href='/" + item.detai + "/" + item.url + "-" + item.baivietId + "' target='_blank'><div class='row clearfix' style='margin:0; display:block'><img src='" + item.thumbnail + "' style='width:10%; margin-right:20px; float:left'/><h4 style='margin-bottom:.5rem; font-size: 22px; color: black'>" + item.tendaydu + " " + year + "</h4><span>" + item.tentv + "</span></div></a>").appendTo(ul);
            }
        };
    })
</script>

        window.onbeforeunload = function (e) {
            countOnlineHub.connection.stop();
        };
        // View
        countOnlineHub.client.showViewsCount = function (data) {
            $('#div_pageview_realtime').text(data);
        };
        // Thông báo
        notificationHub.client.push = function (data) {
            Beep();
            var notiCount = Number($("#notification_count").text());
            $("#notification_count").text(notiCount + 1);
            getNotification();
            $("body").append(
                '<div id="toast-container" class="toast-notification-' + data.Id + ' toast-bottom-left animated fadeInUp">' +
                '<div class="toast toast-info" onclick="ClickDivNotify(\'' + data.url + '\')">' +
                '<div class="toast-image"><img src="' + data.avatar + '"/></div>' +
                '<div class="toast-message"><p style="color:#333">' + data.msg + '</p><p style="margin-top:5px"><span class="' + data.icon + ' toast-icon"></span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="toast-time">vài giây trước</span></p></div>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<button class="toast-close-button" onclick="$(this).parents(\'div\').animateCSS(\'animated fadeOut\', function () { this.remove() })"><i class="fal fa-times"></i></button>' +
                '</div>'
            )
            setTimeout(function () {
                $('.toast-notification-' + data.Id).animateCSS("animated fadeOut", function () { this.remove() })
            }, 10000)
        };
    })
    function ClickDivNotify(url) {
        window.open(url)
    }
    function ClickLinkNotify(e) {
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }
</script>

<script>
    var vaitroId = 0;
    var tagSomeone = 0
    var trang = 1;
    var firstMessage = 0;
    var chatboxInnerHeight = $(".chatbox__messages").innerHeight();
    var chatboxScrollTop = $(".chatbox__messages").scrollTop();
    var chatboxScrollHeight = $(".chatbox__messages")[0].scrollHeight;
    var bottomChatBox = false;

    function UpdateChatBox() {
        chatboxInnerHeight = $(".chatbox__messages").innerHeight();
        chatboxScrollTop = $(".chatbox__messages").scrollTop();
        chatboxScrollHeight = $(".chatbox__messages")[0].scrollHeight;
    }

    $(".chatbox__messages").scroll(function () {
        UpdateChatBox()
        if (chatboxScrollTop + chatboxInnerHeight >= chatboxScrollHeight) {
            bottomChatBox = true
        } else {
            bottomChatBox = false
        }
    });

    // Lắng nghe onConnected
    chatHub.client.onConnected = function (data) {
        AddMessage(data, false);
        ScrollBottom();
        UpdateChatBox();
    }

    // Lắng nghe nếu có tin nhắn mới
    chatHub.client.messageReceived = function (data) {
        AddMessage(data, false);
        $(".btn-avatar-chatbox").html('<img src="'+data[0].avatar+'" class="animated rollIn">')
        UpdateChatBox();
        if (bottomChatBox == true) {
            ScrollBottom();
        }
    }

    // Lắng nghe khi có lệnh xóa
    chatHub.client.remove = function (data) {
        $('#chat-mess-' + data + '').remove();
    }

    // Lắng nghe khi có người nói đến mình
    chatHub.client.beep = function (data) {
        Beep();
        OpenChatBox();
    }

    // Lắng nghe khi có lỗi
    chatHub.client.error = function (data) {
        Swal.fire(data.title, data.content, "error");
    }

    // LoadMore
    var chatbox__messages = $('.chatbox__messages');
    chatbox__messages.scroll(function () {
        var pos = chatbox__messages.scrollTop();
        if (pos == 0) {
            firstMessage = $(".chatbox__messages .chatbox__messageBox").first()
            var curOffset = firstMessage.offset().top - $(".chatbox__messages").scrollTop();
            LoadingMessage(true)
            $.post("/ChatBox/Loadmore", { firstId: firstMessage.attr('data-chatboxId') }, function (data) {
                LoadingMessage(false);
                AddMessage(data, true);
                UpdateChatBox();
                if (data.length > 0) {
                    $(".chatbox__messages").scrollTop(firstMessage.offset().top - curOffset);
                }
            })
        }
    });

    // Enter để chat
    $(".chatbox__inputPanel").keyup(function (event) {
        if (event.keyCode == 13) {
            var text = $('.chatbox__input').data("emojioneArea").getText();
            if ($.trim(text).length > 0) {
                chatHub.server.sendMessageToAll(text, tagSomeone);
                $(".chatbox__input").val("");
                $(".chatbox__inputPanel .emojionearea-editor").html("")
            }
            return false;
        }
    });

    setInterval(function () {
        $('.chatbox__tooltip').each(function () {
            var thoigianthuc = $(this).attr('data-thoigianthuc')
            $(this).text(relative_time(thoigianthuc))
        });
    }, 2000);

    // Thêm tin nhắn
    function AddMessage(data, loadmore) {
        for (i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
            if (loadmore == false) {
                $('.chatbox__messages').append(
                    FormatMessage(data)
                )
            } else {
                $('.chatbox__messages').prepend(
                    FormatMessage(data)
                )
            }
        }
    }

    // Format
    function FormatMessage(data) {
        var ngayviet
        var removeHtml = "";
        if (data[i].ngayviet.includes("Date")) {
            ngayviet = formatdate(data[i].ngayviet)
        } else {
            ngayviet = data[i].ngayviet
        }
        if (vaitroId == 1 || vaitroId == 2) {
            removeHtml = '<div style="float:right;font-size:10px"><a onclick="RemoveMessage(' + data[i].chatboxId + ')" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="fal fa-times"></span></a></div>'
        }
        var formatText = '<div id="chat-mess-' + data[i].chatboxId + '" data-chatboxId="' + data[i].chatboxId + '" class="chatbox__messageBox">' +
            '<div class="chatbox__avatar">' +
            '<img data-taikhoanId="' + data[i].taikhoanId + '" src="' + data[i].avatar + '" onclick="TagMessage(this)">' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="chatbox__message">' +
            '<div class="chatbox__heading"><span><a href="/user/profile/' + data[i].taikhoanId + '" target="blank">' + data[i].ten + '</a></span><span><sup><i class="' + data[i].vaitrologo + '"></i> ' + data[i].vaitro + '</sup></span>' + removeHtml + '</div>' +
            '<p>' + emojione.shortnameToImage(data[i].tinnhan) + '</p>' +
            '<div class="chatbox__tooltip chatbox__tooltip--left" data-thoigianthuc="' + ngayviet + '">' + relative_time(ngayviet) + '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '</div>'
        return formatText
    }

    // Xóa tin nhắn
    function RemoveMessage(chatboxId) {
        chatHub.server.remove(chatboxId)
        return false
    }

    // Loading tin nhắn
    function LoadingMessage(onoff) {
        (onoff == true) ? $(".chatbox__messages").prepend('<div id="chatbox__loading" class="loader" style="width:30px; margin:auto"></div>') : $("#chatbox__loading").remove()
    }

    // Tag
    function TagMessage(i) {
        $("#chatbox__tag").html('<img src="' + i.src + '" onclick="RemoveTagMessage()" style="cursor:pointer">');
        tagSomeone = $(i).attr('data-taikhoanid');
        $('.chatbox__input').focus();
        $('.chatbox__input')[0].emojioneArea.setFocus();
    }

    function RemoveTagMessage() {
        $("#chatbox__tag").html("");
        tagSomeone = 0;
        return false
    }

    function OpenChatBox(e) {
        $('.chatbox').removeClass('closed');
		if (!$(".chatbox__input").hasClass("emojionearea")) {
            $('.chatbox__input').emojioneArea({ saveEmojisAs: 'shortname', pickerPosition: "top" });
        }
        $('.chatbox__input').focus();
        $('.chatbox__input')[0].emojioneArea.setFocus();
        var trang = 1;
		$('#ageGate').remove()
    }

    function CloseChatBox(e) {
        $('.chatbox').addClass('closed');
    }

    function ScrollBottom() {
        $(".chatbox__messages").scrollTop($(".chatbox__messages").height() + 99999999)
    }

    function calculateDateTime(offset) {
        // get current local time in milliseconds
        var date = new Date();
        var localTime = date.getTime();


        // get local timezone offset and convert to milliseconds
        var localOffset = date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000;

        // obtain the UTC time in milliseconds
        var utc = localTime + localOffset;


        var newDateTime = utc + (3600000 * offset);

        var convertedDateTime = new Date(newDateTime);
        return convertedDateTime.toString();
    }

    function relative_time(date_str) {
        //Asia/Bangkok
        if (!date_str) { return; }
        date_str = $.trim(date_str);
        date_str = date_str.replace(/\.\d\d\d+/, "");
        date_str = date_str.replace(/-/, "/").replace(/-/, "/");
        date_str = date_str.replace(/T/, " ").replace(/Z/, " UTC");
        date_str = date_str.replace(/([\+\-]\d\d)\:?(\d\d)/, " $1$2");
        var clientFormatStr = new Date(date_str)
        var currentTime = new Date(calculateDateTime(7).replace(/(\d{2})-(\d{2})-(\d{4})/, "$2/$1/$3"))
        var relative_to = (arguments.length > 1) ? arguments[1] : currentTime;
        var delta = parseInt((relative_to.getTime() - clientFormatStr) / 1000);

        delta = (delta < 2) ? 2 : delta;
        var r = '';
        if (delta < 60) {
            r = delta + ' giây trước';
        } else if (delta < 120) {
            r = '1 phút trước';
        } else if (delta < (45 * 60)) {
            r = (parseInt(delta / 60, 10)).toString() + ' phút trước';
        } else if (delta < (2 * 60 * 60)) {
            r = '1 giờ trước';
        } else if (delta < (24 * 60 * 60)) {
            r = '' + (parseInt(delta / 3600, 10)).toString() + ' giờ trước';
        } else if (delta < (48 * 60 * 60)) {
            r = '1 ngày trước';
        } else {
            r = (parseInt(delta / 86400, 10)).toString() + ' ngày trước';
        }
        return '' + r;
    };

    function formatdate(datestr) {
        var dateString = datestr.substr(6);
        var date = new Date(parseInt(dateString));
        var hours = date.getHours();
        var minutes = date.getMinutes();
        var seconds = date.getSeconds();
        var formattedTime = hours + ':' + minutes + ':' + seconds;
        var month = date.getMonth() + 1;
        var day = date.getDate();
        var year = date.getFullYear();
        var formatdate = year + "-" + (month < 10 ? '0' : '') + month + '-' + (day < 10 ? '0' : '') + day;
        return formatdate + "T" + formattedTime
    }
</script>
